description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'GenericAsyncEngine' which extends 'AbstractEngine' to facilitate asynchronous service execution within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes method implementations for running services synchronously and asynchronously, handling job creation and persistence, and managing execution contexts. The class serves as a base for concrete implementations related to async engine behavior.

classes.name: GenericAsyncEngine
classes.description: An abstract class providing async service execution mechanisms, including scheduling, persistence, and job management within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Abstract method to execute a service synchronously, returning a result map.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Abstract method to execute a service synchronously, ignoring the result.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Executes a service asynchronously, with optional persistence and requester handling.

methods.name: allowCallbacks
methods.description: Determines if callbacks are allowed based on the service mode.
